metadata.question: Does central Oklahoma experience more rainfall compared to northen Texas during August 10-20, 2007?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use CHIRPS precipitation data for rainfall comparison - Date range: August 10-20, 2007 - Locations: Central Oklahoma vs Northern Texas - CHIRPS dataset: 'UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY' has good coverage and reliability 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for CHIRPS (precipitation product) - Direct comparison of total rainfall during the period 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Rainfall = 0 mm is valid (dry period) - Check collection size first (C1 if no data) - Check pixel counts (C2 if no valid pixels) - Check if results are None/null (C3) - Compare: Oklahoma rainfall > Texas rainfall → A, else → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const centralOklahoma = ee.Geometry.Point([-97.5, 35.5]); const northernTexas = ee.Geometry.Point([-97.0, 33.5]); const startDate = '2007-08-10'; const endDate = '2007-08-21'; // Exclusive end date for 10-20 range // 2. Data Acquisition const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const oklaCol = chirps.filterBounds(centralOklahoma); const texasCol = chirps.filterBounds(northernTexas); const oklaSize = oklaCol.size().getInfo(); const texasSize = texasCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Oklahoma Images: ${oklaSize}`); console.log(`Texas Images: ${texasSize}`); if (oklaSize === 0 || texasSize === 0) { console.log("No data found for one or both locations."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum rainfall over the period const oklaTotal = oklaCol.sum(); const texasTotal = texasCol.sum(); // 4. Calculate total rainfall const oklaStats = oklaTotal.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: centralOklahoma, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const texasStats = texasTotal.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: northernTexas, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const oklaRainfall = oklaStats.precipitation; const texasRainfall = texasStats.precipitation; console.log(`Oklahoma Rainfall: ${oklaRainfall !== null ? oklaRainfall.toFixed(2) : 'null'} mm`); console.log(`Texas Rainfall: ${texasRainfall !== null ? texasRainfall.toFixed(2) : 'null'} mm`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (oklaRainfall === null || texasRainfall === null || oklaRainfall === undefined || texasRainfall === undefined) { console.log("Calculation failed - null result."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (isNaN(oklaRainfall) || isNaN(texasRainfall)) { console.log("Calculation failed - NaN result."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (oklaRainfall > texasRainfall) { console.log("Central Oklahoma has more rainfall than northern Texas."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Central Oklahoma does NOT have more rainfall than northern Texas."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
